answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by tokens locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. Fake accounts may mirror each other’s votes, but splitting a fixed stake among them adds no voting power. An attacker cannot forge extra weight by creating identities: to control 51% of the vote, it must acquire and lock 51% of the voting stake. Even a swarm that arrives like a comet must pay the capital cost and lose access to those funds during the lock.
